card.name: Small words in drug interaction sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as in, to, by, were, effect, increase in drug-interaction sentences, right after the interacting drug or the result verb. Also fires on a few words like just or plug in step-by-step math explanations.

modes.description: Linking word or verb after a drug is given or after a change is reported, just before the effect on another drug.
